name: Aquascene Magnetic Island
summary: A family-run operator on Magnetic Island, off Townsville in North Queensland, running small-group snorkel and eco tours with Master Reef Guides. Day tours leave from Nelly Bay Marina, with a Townsville departure on set days, and there are sunset, whale watching and private charter options. Snorkel gear, a floating pontoon and morning tea are provided on the day tours.
standouts: Advanced Eco Certified through Ecotourism Australia
Owners Adam and Steph Hinks are Master Reef Guides and are on board to share the reef's stories
Gold for Adventure Tourism at the Queensland Tourism Awards
Family owned and run on Magnetic Island since 2004

trips.title: Discovery Eco Tour
trips.summary: A morning snorkel tour of Magnetic Island's bays and fringing reefs, led by Master Reef Guides who talk about the reef, the wildlife and the island's history. It leaves from Nelly Bay Marina each morning, stops for morning tea at a beach chosen on the day, and focuses on the best snorkel spots on the eastern side of the island. Whale watching is part of the trip from July to September.
highlights: Snorkelling on fringing reefs, with a snorkel lesson and briefing

Paddleboards, viewing boogie boards and a floating pontoon provided

trips.requirements: Suitable for all ages and abilities, and some swimming ability is recommended (flotation aids and a floating pontoon are available). Young children must be accompanied by 2 adults. Guests complete an emailed waiver form before the tour and must tell the crew about any medical condition. The ferry ticket to Magnetic Island is not included.

trips.title: Townsville Departure Discovery Eco Tour
trips.summary: The Discovery Eco Tour run from Townsville instead of Nelly Bay, on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays. The boat leaves from the Breakwater Marina in Townsville at 7:30 am, spends the day snorkelling and exploring Magnetic Island's bays with Master Reef Guides, and returns at 2 pm. Guests who want to stay on the island afterwards can tell the skipper and take the Sealink ferry back.

trips.title: Circumnavigation Explorer Tour
trips.summary: A full lap of Magnetic Island by boat, leaving Nelly Bay Marina at 8:30 am on selected days each week. The route takes in the northern side of the island, including the Five Bays when weather allows, with time to swim, snorkel and spend on beaches using paddle boards and other water toys. Guides share stories and history along the way, and morning tea is provided.

trips.title: Sunset & Shipwreck Tour
trips.summary: A two hour sunset cruise from Nelly Bay Marina along the coast towards Cockle Bay, ending at the wreck of the S.S. City of Adelaide. Guests stay on the boat while the crew tells the ship's story and some of the island's maritime history, with birdlife and photo stops at sunset. It runs only on selected dates when the tide and sunset line up, and guests bring their own drinks and nibbles.

trips.title: Whales at Sunset Tour
trips.summary: A three hour sunset whale watching cruise on the vessel Kanyini, with afternoon tea and live whale song played through onboard listening equipment. Guests hear the story of Kanyini, a whale with a special place in Aquascene's story. It runs from July to September, timed to the humpback migration past Magnetic Island's coast.

trips.title: Northern Islands Adventure
trips.summary: A small-group day trip north of Magnetic Island to Acheron Island, with snorkelling, swimming and beach time. The day runs from 8:30 am to 3 pm on selected dates and includes morning tea and lunch, reef education and citizen science. It is a new tour for Aquascene in the Townsville region.

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: Private charters of Aquascene's custom catamarans from Nelly Bay Marina, for social, corporate, school, wedding and birthday groups of up to 50 guests using both vessels. The day is built around the group, with reef snorkelling, paddle boards, glass bottom boogie boards and talks about the island, adjusted to weather and tides. A skipper and host come with the boat.
